reasons: no provable trap detected. This is NOT a safety rating: it means none of the checks that can PROVE a trap (NO_EXIT_VENUE, EXIT_LIQUIDITY_DRAINED, TRADING_DISABLED) fired at this block, AND the liquidity sweep reached a conclusion (liquidityCoverage.conclusive). Structural risk — age, holder concentration, liquidity depth, transfer restrictions — is reported in risk_profile and can still be severe

age.note: age measured from the first transfer seen on this chain

concentration.note: holder shares read on this call; pool, bridge and treasury contracts are addresses too

liquidity.note: the dollars a sell can actually REACH, across up to two hops; the pot takes the bottleneck of the two hops, never their sum

oracle.note: no first-party feed; price comes from the pools themselves

transferRestrictions.note: measured by simulating a transfer at this block

disclaimer: Informational on-chain liquidity data, not financial advice.
